capabilities: Expand reusable note fragments by note, line range, section or tag
Pass positional arguments and variables into fragments
Preview and copy expanded text from a block toolbar
Create a sibling note with references expanded in prose and fenced blocks
Limit fragment lookup to marked package folders
disambiguation: Not a code snippet embedder; it expands reusable note fragments and structured prompts.
extras: Development build; install by copying dist files into .obsidian/plugins/code-embed/. Settings cover language, package folder and block toolbar opacity.
problem: Shared instructions and prompt fragments must be copied manually into each note, so edits do not propagate.
summary: Plugin that expands reusable note fragments with selectors, arguments and variables, and previews or copies the result.
